events.description: Microsoft held its 2021 Annual Shareholders Meeting; shareholders voted to elect each of the twelve nominees for director.
events.quote: On November 30, 2021, Microsoft Corporation (the “Company”) held its 2021 Annual Shareholders Meeting (the “Annual Meeting”). There were 7,507,897,348 shares of common stock entitled to be voted at the Annual Meeting, of which 6,409,615,083 were voted in person or by proxy.

events.description: Shareholders approved, on an advisory basis, the compensation of the Company's named executive officers (95.45% votes for).
events.quote: (2) Approved, on an advisory basis, the compensation of the Company’s named executive officers.

events.description: Shareholders approved the Microsoft Employee Stock Purchase Plan (99.65% votes for).
events.quote: (3) Approved the Microsoft Employee Stock Purchase Plan

events.description: Shareholders ratified the appointment of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2022.
events.quote: (4) Voted to ratify the appointment of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2022.

events.description: Shareholders approved a shareholder proposal concerning a report on the effectiveness of workplace sexual harassment policies (77.97% votes for).
events.quote: (6) Approved a shareholder proposal concerning a report on the effectiveness of workplace sexual harassment policies.

events.description: Shareholders rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on median pay gaps across race and gender (40.04% votes for).
events.quote: (5) Rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on median pay gaps across race and gender.

events.description: Shareholders rejected a shareholder proposal to prohibit sales of facial recognition technology to all government entities (4.05% votes for).
events.quote: (7) Rejected a shareholder proposal to prohibit sales of facial recognition technology to all government entities.

events.description: Shareholders rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on the implementation of the Fair Chance Business Pledge (13.83% votes for).
events.quote: (8) Rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on the implementation of the Fair Chance Business Pledge.

events.description: Shareholders rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on how lobbying activities align with Company policies (38.04% votes for).
events.quote: (9) Rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on how lobbying activities align with Company policies.
